The Voice of Hind Rajab wins the Silver Lion in Venice

Kaouther Ben Hania's film receives the Grand Jury Prize at the 82nd Venice Film Festival.

Film · Sep 2025

The Voice of Hind Rajab, written and directed by Kaouther Ben Hania, won the Silver Lion — Grand Jury Prize at the 82nd Venice International Film Festival, after a record 23-minute standing ovation.

The film tells the story of Hind Rajab, a six-year-old girl trapped in a car under fire in Gaza, through the real recordings of her call to Red Crescent volunteers.

Guillaume and Sarah Rambourg are executive producers of the film — the continuation of a collaboration with Kaouther Ben Hania that began with The Man Who Sold His Skin.
